lines.text: Inline formulas break after relations and binary operations when a line is
full: the identity a1 + a2 + a3 + a4 + a5 + a6 + a7 + a8 = b1 + b2 + b3 + b4 is long
enough to reach the end of a line, and so is (x + y)2 = x2 + 2xy + y2  2x2 + 2y2
